rta-main.limitations: The private image passed all ten RTA Labs and ten quizzes (189 code cells) and six actual browser checks on one fresh validation instance. Three clones had distinct Docker engine, machine and token identities, completed concurrent Lab 1, and passed shared authentication, six-direction HTTP/API and kernel/terminal WebSocket isolation, entry logout/reauthentication and single-service recovery. All Labs were not run concurrently on every host. Pressure and host replacement have separate historical evidence. First-login password changes, hosted-login branding, remote GitHub Actions, larger events and other variants are outside this round.

dw-main.limitations: Verified together as the complete six-profile selection on Linux x86_64/us-east-1/m7i.2xlarge/200GiB. The private image passed 34 Notebooks/204 code cells and eight real browser checks on one fresh validation instance; three shared clones each completed the entire selection (102 Notebooks/612 cells). All three passed ownership, SQL, terminal, six-direction HTTP/API and kernel/terminal WebSocket isolation and entry logout/reauthentication. FE/profile GUI was checked for s001, Superset/Flink GUI for s002; shared native Notebook save/rename/reopen/download/reload was checked for s001. All temporary cloud resources were retired and reconciled. Cold frontend loads produced recorded timeouts, so performance, larger classrooms and other combinations are not certified. First-login password changes, hosted-login branding and natural session/long-idle behavior remain outside this round.

obs-main.limitations: Verified together as English legacy schema-v1 obs-main plus obs-local-model on Linux x86_64/us-east-1/m7i.2xlarge/200GiB. One fresh instance passed 29 audits, 17 Notebooks/148 cells and 14 browser checks; three shared clones each completed all 17/148 (51/444 total) with distinct identities, six browser gates, ownership and HTTP/API/WebSocket isolation, logout/reauthentication, CPU-load entry/SQL, exact browser-to-Doris trace correlation and application recovery. All temporary cloud resources were retired and reconciled. Shared browser checks used AWS-hosted Chromium 156; external-client delivery remains unqualified after a macOS Grafana asset truncation. Temporary browser OOM, Jupyter save conflicts and stale pages required recorded recovery; no performance guarantee, larger-event, translated/v2, other-selection, first-password-change/MFA, natural-session or long-idle qualification. Litefuse parent-domain PostHog analytics privacy/isolation was not certified.
